job.description:
Contact Name: Chintan Tanna

Contact Email: chintan@omegamedical.com.au

Contact Phone: 02 8005 3445

Specialty: Sonography

Grade: HP4 – Experienced Professional

Rate: Rates to be advised

Dates: 21 Sep to 01 Nov 2026

Travel: Provided

Accommodation: Provided

Client Description

  • Major Public hospital for the Central Queensland Region, that is well equipped with leading edge technology to operate as a fully digital facility. The facility has a great working environment, encourages professional development and supporting staff is their priority.

Mandatory Experience

General:

  • Abdo/Renal US
  • Liver/Liver elastography

Small parts:

  • Thyroid/neck
  • Breasts/axilla
  • Soft tissue/lumps/collections
  • Testes

Vascular:

  • Leg vein/DVT
  • Arm veins/DVT
  • Carotids
  • Aorta

Obstetrics/Gynae:

  • Pelvis
  • 1st Trimester (Not Nuchals)
  • Morphology
  • 3rd Trimester/ AFI & Dopplers

Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of ieMR and proficiency in using this system
  • Previous experience working in Australia, QLD Health and/or Mackay HHS

MSK:

  • Basic MSK preferable but not mandatory

Paediatrics:

  • Basic paeds scans such as abdomen/renal/DDH preferable but not mandatory

Mandatory Competencies

  • Australian Sonographer Accreditation Registry (ASAR) or AHPRA Registration (RAD/SONO)
  • Basic life support
  • Manual and patient handling
  • Infection control including hand hygiene
  • Occupational Violence Prevention Training incorporating de-escalation skills, situational awareness, and maintaining personal safety
  • Mandatory reporting of reasonable suspicions of child abuse and neglect

Additionally, the candidate must agree to undertake any of the following as required by our HHS:

  • Integrated electronic medical record training
  • Online induction training
  • Any other training as requested


For more information, please Apply or contact Chintan Tanna on 02 8005 3445 or email chintan@omegamedical.com.au

job.description:
About the Opportunity

We're partnering with a well-established national allied health organisation seeking an Accredited Exercise Physiologist to join their collaborative team with opportunities in Townsville, QLD

This is an excellent opportunity to work within a genuine multidisciplinary environment, delivering evidence-based care across a broad range of funding streams while receiving structured clinical support and clear career development opportunities.

Whether you're a new graduate looking for strong mentorship or an experienced EP seeking greater clinical variety, this role offers the support and autonomy to thrive.

The Role

You'll manage a varied caseload across:

  • DVA

  • Medicare (EPC)

  • NDIS

  • Home Care Packages

  • Workers Compensation

  • Private clients

Your work will include clinic, community and home-based services, allowing you to build broad clinical skills while making a meaningful difference to your clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments and functional evaluations

  • Develop and deliver individualised exercise programs

  • Provide one-on-one and small group exercise interventions

  • Monitor client progress and modify treatment plans

  • Collaborate closely with physiotherapists, occupational therapists, podiatrists, dietitians and other health professionals

  • Complete high-quality clinical documentation

  • Educate clients on self-management, injury prevention and long-term health outcomes

What's on Offer

  • Structured mentorship and clinical supervision

  • Comprehensive graduate development program

  • Ongoing professional development and CPD support

  • Genuine multidisciplinary team environment

  • Diverse and rewarding caseload across multiple funding streams

  • Clear career progression into senior, leadership and management pathways

  • Employee wellbeing program and retail discounts

  • Supportive, collaborative team culture

  • National organisation with extensive career opportunities

About You

You will have:

  • ESSA Accredited Exercise Physiologist (or eligibility)

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Exercise Physiology

  • Current driver's licence and reliable vehicle

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with DVA, NDIS, Medicare or Home Care clients

  • Private practice or community health experience

  • Interest in chronic disease management, rehabilitation, pain management or healthy ageing

  • Experience delivering group exercise programs

Why Apply?

This role offers the best of both worlds—the clinical autonomy of private practice combined with the support, mentorship and career opportunities of a large allied health network.

If you're looking for genuine clinical variety, ongoing development and a team that invests in your success, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Occupational Therapist (Clinic based / Sponsorship Available)
job.description:
Singleton NSW | Full-time or Part-time | $95K–$115K + super + 40% bonus structure

Are you an experienced Occupational Therapist ready to step into a role where your clinical expertise and leadership can genuinely make an impact?

This is a unique opportunity for a Senior OT to take ownership of a new OT service in Singleton, with the autonomy to build your caseload, shape clinical services and help establish the OT division as it grows.

You’ll have the freedom of a senior role, backed by the resources, professional development and established network of a leading national allied health organisation.

Why this role?

  • $95K–$115K + super + 40% bonus structure, based on experience

  • Full-time or part-time — ideally 3–4 days per week

  • Lead and build a new OT service from the ground up

  • High level of autonomy and ownership over your caseload

  • Opportunity to mentor and lead future OTs joining the team

  • Modern, purpose-built multidisciplinary clinic

  • Dedicated treatment spaces and clinical equipment provided

  • Strong support from an established national network

  • Professional development opportunities

  • AHPRA registration reimbursed annually

  • Professional Indemnity Insurance fully covered

  • Salary sacrifice options

  • Up to 30% discounts on services and products

  • Visa transfer/sponsorship available for the right candidate

The opportunity

As the Senior OT, you’ll be more than a clinician — you’ll play a key role in establishing and growing the OT service.

You’ll have the autonomy to develop your own caseload, work within your areas of clinical interest and help shape how the service operates. As the division grows, there is the opportunity to provide clinical leadership and support future OT team members.

The role will involve:

  • Managing your own clinical caseload

  • Conducting comprehensive assessments and developing evidence-informed intervention plans

  • Providing high-quality OT assessment and treatment

  • Working across paediatric and/or adult caseloads, depending on your experience and interests

  • Building strong relationships with clients, families, referrers and other professionals

  • Collaborating with the broader multidisciplinary team

  • Maintaining high-quality clinical documentation and reporting

  • Supporting the development and growth of the OT service

  • Providing clinical leadership as the team expands

About you

You’re an experienced OT who is confident working autonomously and ready to take ownership.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Tertiary qualification in Occupational Therapy

  • Current AHPRA registration

  • Strong clinical OT experience

  • Experience in private practice, NDIS and/or community settings

  • Confidence independently managing a caseload

  • Strong clinical reasoning and evidence-informed practice

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Strong organisation and time management

  • A genuine interest in building something and taking it to the next level

Paediatric experience is highly regarded, but the focus is on finding a Senior OT who can build an effective caseload around their clinical strengths.

This is your opportunity to make your mark.

If you’re looking for a Senior OT position where you can step away from simply managing a caseload and have a genuine say in building a service, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About the Opportunity
An established and growing allied health provider is seeking Podiatrists to join their network across multiple locations in Australia. This organisation offers a highly supportive environment with strong clinical development pathways, access to modern technology, and opportunities to progress into leadership or specialised clinical roles.

You’ll be joining a collaborative multidisciplinary team, working within well-equipped clinics and supported by experienced mentors and structured professional development programs.

What’s on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based incentives
  • Additional regional and relocation support (where applicable)
  • Flexible working arrangements (including options such as a 9-day fortnight)
  • Ongoing clinical mentoring and structured career progression pathways
  • Access to internal professional development programs and regular training sessions
  • Employee wellbeing support programs
  • Discounts, salary packaging, and novated leasing options
  • Referral bonus incentives
  • Sponsor

The Role
You will manage a varied and engaging caseload across all areas of podiatry, with access to advanced tools and technology to support best-practice care.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Conducting comprehensive assessments across musculoskeletal, diabetic, and general podiatry presentations
  • Managing a diverse patient base including paediatrics, adults, aged care, and NDIS participants
  • Prescribing and fitting orthotics and footwear solutions
  • Delivering a range of treatments using modern equipment and techniques
  • Providing education and preventative care strategies to patients

Clinical Scope Includes

  • General podiatry and foot care
  • Diabetic foot management
  • Nail surgery
  • Musculoskeletal conditions
  • Orthotics (including advanced/custom solutions)
  • Paediatrics
  • NDIS caseloads
  • Access to modalities such as shockwave therapy and other innovative treatments

About You

  • Qualified Podiatrist with current registration (or eligibility)
  • Strong clinical reasoning and a patient-centred approach
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Interest in ongoing professional development and career growth

This NSW Hospital is one of two large public hospitals on the Central Coast. It is a busy regional hospital of approximately 300 beds and is a teaching hospital of the University of Newcastle.
